modern: Receive wealth or prosperity without arrogance; and be ready to let it go.
original: Receive [wealth or prosperity] without arrogance; and be ready to let it go.
notification: Receive wealth or prosperity without arrogance; and be ready to let it go.
notification_original: Receive [wealth or prosperity] without arrogance; and be ready to let it go.

explained.summary: Accept wealth and success without getting arrogant about them, and be ready to let them go. Good fortune is borrowed, not owned, so hold it lightly in both directions.
explained.today: Enjoy the pay rise, the bigger house or the run of good luck without letting it change how you treat people, and without building your sense of self on keeping them.
